headline: Approved purchase of four vehicles and a field tractor, power purchasing agreements for four district buildings, and a $206,640 BlazerWorks staffing contract.
summary: The meeting included a $3,000 donation to school nurses and a presentation on spring 2026 test data. Members approved vehicle and tractor purchases, power purchasing agreements, and several staffing and special education contracts. Members also heard public comment on special education.
decisions: Approved purchase of four vehicles and a field tractor from Grappone Ford and M.B. Tractor, funded by the City of Nashua CERF account, 8-0.
Approved power purchasing agreements for Main Dunstable Elementary, Birch Hill Elementary, Bicentennial Elementary, and the School Administration Building, funded by solar savings, 8-0.
Approved contract with ACM Staffing LLC for 0.6 FTE SLP, not to exceed $79,560.00, 8-0.
Approved contract with Beyond Words LLC for 0.4 FTE SLP, not to exceed $46,800.00, 8-0.
Approved contract with Champion Speech Therapy and Contracting Services LLC for 0.2 FTE SLP and 1.0 SLPA, not to exceed $90,935.00, 8-0.
Approved contract amendment increasing the SLP Mama-to-be LLC contract by $30,030.00, to a total not to exceed $76,930.00, 8-0.
Approved contract with Amergis Healthcare Staffing, Inc. for 1.0 FTE BT, not to exceed $43,680.00, 8-0.
Approved contract with BlazerWorks LLC for 20 hours per week BCBA and 2.0 FTE RBT, not to exceed $206,640.00, 8-0.
Approved contract with Daniel Chick for up to 20 hours per week of special education services, not to exceed $57,000.00, 8-0.
Approved the FY27 September Transfer Report, 8-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Raymond, to approve the Consent Agenda. Motion passes 7-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the purchase of four (4) vehicles from Grappone Ford in the following amounts, One-ton Dump Truck $92,735; F250 Pickup with Cab $77,127; Maverick Pick-up Truck $36,605; and a Field Tractor from M.B. Tractor via Sourcewell for $65,143.07. Funding will come from the City of Nashua CERF account. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the Nashua School District entering into Power Purchasing Agreements for Main Dunstable Elementary, Birch Hill Elementary, Bicentennial Elementary, and the School Administration Building. Funding will come from solar savings realized in the electricity budget. ... Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with ACM Staffing LLC for staffing of 0.6 FTE SLP for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $79,560.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Beyond Words LLC for staffing of 0.4 FTE SLP for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $46,800.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Champion Speech Therapy and Contracting Services LLC for staffing of 0.2 FTE SLP and 1.0 SLPA for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $90,935.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract amendment to increase the contract with SLP Mama-to-be LLC by $30,030.00, for regular, weekly staffing of 0.4 FTE SLP, for the 2026-2027 school year, at a total cost not to exceed $76,930.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Amergis Healthcare Staffing, Inc. for staffing of 1.0 FTE BT for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $43,680.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Budget. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with BlazerWorks LLC for staffing of 20 hours per week BCBA and 2.0 FTE RBT for the 2026-2027 school year at a total cost not to exceed $206,640.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 8-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Daniel Chick for up to 20 hours per week of Special Education Instruction and Services for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $57,000.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 8-0.
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the FY27 September Transfer Report. Motion passes 8-0.

BOARD OF EDUCATION 
WEDNESAY, OCTOBER 28, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Board of Education was held at NHS North on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.  Ms. Bishop 
called the meeting to order at 5:04 pm and asked Ms. Raymond to read the opening statement and Mr. 
Johnson to lead the Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
Present: Ms. Giglio, Ms. Prinn (6:24 pm arrival), Mr. Johnson, Ms. Raymond, Ms. Lewis, Mr. Salvi, Ms. 
Lamphier, and Ms. Bishop 
 
Also Present:  Dr. Andrade, Dr. Scarpati, Mr. O’Rourke 
Also Present:  Members of the Public, Channel 99 Videographer 
  
PRESENTATION:   
1.  Nashua Lions Club:  Paula Ralph and Mary Ann Melizzi-Golja presented Jeana Lopez, Head Nurse, with 
$3000 donation to assist school nurses with providing snacks to students in need. 
2. SAS Spring 2026 Data Overview:  Dr. Scarpati and Mr. O’Rourke presented the BOE with data in the 
subjects of ELA, Math, and Science (grades 5, 8, and 11 only). 
 
CONSENT AGENDA 
 
Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Raymond, to approve the Consent Agenda.  Motion passes 7-0. 
 
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT AGENDA 
 
COMMUNICATIONS OUTSIDE THE CONSENT AGENDA 
 
PUBLIC QUESTION/COMMENT PERIOD LIMITED TO ITEMS ON THIS AGENDA 
• Gary Hoffman, NTU President:  Presented the Nashua Teachers Union’s special education resolution 
calling for reduced unnecessary paperwork, a statewide staffing task force, improved state and federal 
funding, and greater focus on direct services.  
• Lindsay LeBrun, District Behavior Analyst:  Described serving 16 schools, more than 25 programs, 
and over 150 students amid staffing shortages and extensive documentation. 
 
SUPERINTENDENT’S COMMENTS 
• Dr. Andrade shared district success stories from all schools, including a student named a 2026 U.S. 
Presidential Scholar and literacy and student-support initiatives across schools. 
 
BOARD RESPONSE TO SUPERINTENDENT’S COMMENTS 
• Board members thanked and appreciated the updates. 
 
STUDENT REPRESENTATIVE COMMENTS 
• Appreciates hearing about the elementary students and school happenings. 
 
COMMITTEE ON BUDGET 
 
COMMITTEE ON FINANCE AND OPERATIONS 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the purchase of four (4) vehicles from Grappone 
Ford in the following amounts, One-ton Dump Truck $92,735; F250 Pickup with Cab $77,127; Maverick

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the Nashua School District entering into Power 
Purchasing Agreements for Main Dunstable Elementary, Birch Hill Elementary, Bicentennial Elementary, 
and the School Administration Building.  Funding will come from solar savings realized in the electricity 
budget.   
 
• Board members questioned that the approval of this motion considering the vote in November on 
potential school closures. 
• Dan Weeks, Revision Energy, assured the board that within the time it takes to set up the contracts 
and execution, the board could remove a school from the contract should they decide to close it.  
 
Motion passes 8-0.

cost not to exceed $90,935.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services.  
Motion passes 8-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract amendment to increase the contract 
with SLP Mama-to-be LLC by $30,030.00, for regular, weekly staffing of 0.4 FTE SLP, for the 2026-2027 
school year, at a total cost not to exceed $76,930.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under 
Contracted Services.  Motion passes 8-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Amergis Healthcare Staffing, 
Inc. for staffing of 1.0 FTE BT for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $43,680.00.  Funding 
to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Budget.  Motion passes 8-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with BlazerWorks LLC for staffing of 
20 hours per week BCBA and 2.0 FTE RBT for the 2026-2027 school year at a total cost not to exceed 
$206,640.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services.  Motion passes 8-
0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Daniel Chick for up to 20 hours 
per week of Special Education Instruction and Services for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to 
exceed $57,000.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services.  Motion

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the FY27 September Transfer Report.  Motion

UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
 
NEW BUSINESS 
 
• The District is asking the BOE to sign both the DOE-25 and the MS-25 annual reports.  No motion is 
required. 
• Three special education advisory meetings were announced for December (12/2/26 at Ledge Street 
Elementary, 12/9/26 at Dr. Crisp Elementary, and 12/16/26 at Fairgrounds Middle School).
